pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] Sev 2 — repeated egress gateway errors from scl1 (southamerica-scl1). 503s observed on /v1/generate and /v1/embed, ~40% of requests failing for a subset of prefixes. Pager: multiple customers impacted. Link: https://pd.example/INC-2187654321

Caroline: ack-ing, taking command. Paging Lina and Ajay. Lina, can you confirm blast radius and whether this is NAT/gateway vs infra?

Lina M.: seeing a spike of TCP resets from egress-gw-2.scl1 -> peer ISPs. Hypothesis: gateway's egress NIC stuck in L2 flaps, kernel OOMs around 09:12 UTC. Stack traces show `nf_conntrack` saturating. 40% failures mostly from Chile/Peru prefixes, Brazil customers partially degraded.

Ajay K.: on it. I'm going to isolate egress-gw-2 and shift BGP preprefs to egress-gw-1 and the brazil-peers. Starting runbook step 3 (isolate gateway) now. If isolation fails, we have a fallback option to route heavy embed traffic through us-east1 egress.

Caroline: timeline please and customer impact for status page. Samir, can you draft a status message?

Samir P.: Draft below. Short + actionable; will post to status page and customer workspace once approved.

```\nStatus: Partial service degradation in SCL1 (South America - Santiago) impacting text generation and embeddings for some customers in Chile and Peru.

Current: Engineers have isolated a problematic egress gateway and are rerouting traffic. Some requests may see increased latency as traffic is diverted to neighboring regions.

Next update: 30 minutes or earlier if we have a mitigation.

What you can expect: 1) Temporary elevated latency for affected requests. 2) No data loss; retries should succeed.
```

Caroline: looks good. Add note about affected model endpoints: all /v1/generate and /v1/embed variants using the region-prefixed host (scl1.*). Also include helpful contact for customers with SLAs.

Samir P.: updated draft with SLA contact. Also preparing customer email template — short and non-technical.

opsbot: runbook step 3 completed: egress-gw-2 removed from load balancer pool. BGP prepref shift in progress (announce to brasil-peers and us-east1 fallback). Logs: 

```
# last 5 lines from egress-gw-2 kernel log
[09:12:01] nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
[09:12:02] kernel: oom_kill_process invoked
[09:12:03] linkdown: eth0 down
[09:12:05] systemd: egress-gw-2 stopped
```

Lina M.: verified connections rerouted. Observed increased p95 latency from 120ms -> 430ms for customers now hitting brasil-peers. Error rate reduced from 40% -> 8% after isolation. Still seeing retries failing for some long-lived websocket sessions.

Ajay K.: starting traffic shift for embed-heavy customers to us-east1 fallback via policy tag `fallback:us-east`. Will modify routing policy for active contracts only to avoid capacity overload. Command run: 

```
redwoodctl route update --region scl1 --traffic-rule "type=prefix,match=chile,action=redirect,peer=us-east1" --dry-run=false
```

Caroline: please capture which customers were shifted (we need to include in the customer comms). Lina, can you pull a list of prefixes/customers with >2% error rate in last 10m?

Lina M.: running query now, will paste CSV in the incident doc. Early list: cust-102 (Santiago fintech), cust-217 (analytics), cust-331 (edu).

Samir P.: customer-facing email template (short):

"Hello — we're experiencing partial degradation for customers routed via our SCL1 egress. We've isolated the faulty gateway and are rerouting traffic; you may see higher latency for a short period. No data loss is expected. We'll update you within 30 minutes. If you need immediate assistance, reply or open a support ticket and mention INC-2187654321."

Caroline: good. Also prepare internal incident comms for account teams so AE/CS can proactively reach out to top-tier customers. Samir can you make a Slack DM template for AE?

Samir P.: AE DM: `Hi <AE name>, FYI customers <list> were affected by SCL1 egress isolation. We're mitigating and have routed traffic via BRA1/US-EAST fallback. ETA for stable baseline ~45m. Please hold high-touch outreach until our 2nd update.`

statusbot: Status page updated to "partial_degradation" for southamerica-scl1. Public update posted with incident ID INC-2187654321.

Caroline: on-call handoff note — I'm going to hand to Ajay after I brief him. Ajay, you'll be primary for the next shift; Lina you'll stay as subject matter expert. Please keep channel updated every 15 minutes or on major events.

Ajay K.: acknowledged. Current action items for me: 1) Confirm embed reroute success and watch capacity in us-east1, 2) monitor p99 and error rates, 3) coordinate postmortem run when incident resolves.

Lina M.: posted CSV of affected prefixes and customer mapping to the incident doc: `scl1_affected_prefixes.csv`. Also added a snippet for postmortem about nf_conntrack tuning that we may need.

Caroline: thanks. Quick note for status page follow-up: add bullet that we will post a timeline + RCA within 72 hours. Samir, include that in the next status update.

Samir P.: will do. Preparing 15-min update now.

opsbot: monitoring alert: p95 latency back to 180ms; error rate steady at 6%. No new flaps detected in last 5m.

Caroline: handing command to Ajay at 09:42 UTC. Ajay please escalate to SRE lead if error rate >10% or if us-east1 capacity >75%. Posting handoff message to #incidents-ops.

Ajay K.: taking command. leaving final note here before I move to the war room: `INC-2187654321 | SCL1 egress gateway isolation — mitigation in progress. Primary: Ajay K. SME: Lina M. Next update: +15m or on change.` :thumbsup:

Caroline: closing my leadership loop — moving to advisory role. Good work team.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: follow post-incident checklist (notify customers, collect logs, assign RCA owners).

Samir P.: I'll draft the RCA owners list and proposed timeline in the incident doc.

opsbot: incident thread archived to incidents archive after last update.
